name: Rat Cranium
source: A jaded detective spends his days handling routine investigations. But as strange clues begin appearing in case after case, he starts tracing the outlines of an urban legend lurking beneath the city. To uncover the truth, he will have to confront it directly and risk everything.
translation: 一位疲惫不堪的侦探整天忙于处理例行调查。但随着一个又一个案件中奇怪的线索开始出现，他开始追踪潜伏在城市之下的都市传说的轮廓。为了揭开真相，他必须直面真相，不惜一切代价。
